visualCharacteristics: Standalone full-viewport (100vh/100svh) hero, NOT a carousel. Background picture (desktop + optional mobile portrait). Heading "MG SELECT x GAURAV GUPTA" cleaned of list bullets/hyphens. EXPLORE outlined button with arrow. "Book M9 Couture Edition" / "Book Cyberster Couture Edition" pills anchored with position:absolute to top-right of the mg-hero block (block is position:relative). Dismissible pills.
